text:
Fatal accident to a crew member on board the Bermuda registered passenger vessel Arvia
Location: on passage from Southampton, England, to Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain.
Accident Investigation Report 20/2026
Read our marine accident investigation report, which includes what happened, subsequent actions taken and recommendations.
Summary
At about 0552 on 26 October 2025, a crew member on board the Bermuda registered passenger vessel Arvia was fatally injured while inspecting a passenger lift. The vessel was on passage from Southampton, England, to Santa Cruz de Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain.
Safety issues
- Communication and planning for the inspection were ineffective.
- Control of the lift had not been established before the crew member entered the lift shaft.
- Self-resetting door interlocks were relied on as a safety barrier against lift movement.
- Permit to work arrangements did not identify that the task had moved beyond the authorised scope of work.
- Lift maintenance training and competence assurance were inconsistent.
Recommendations
Carnival UK Ltd has been recommended to review the use of self-resetting lift door interlocks as a safety barrier to prevent activation of lifts during maintenance or inspection.
